items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: There was Tizol and Barney and all the guys, Lawrence Brown, everybody.

ctx.x: Did you get a charge out of that?

Oh yeah, oh God, yeah, I just loved sitting in there with Duke. Was the last set, you know, they had closed the books and was probably just a lot of those numbers that I knew, like 'Take the A Train' and all those things you know, heads, and just sitting down there and play them. That was my only time ever playing with Duke. I loved that band, though, playing with the band. There was Tizol and Barney and all the guys, Lawrence Brown, everybody.
Why don't we talk about Frankie Newton, back to him. You did some records with him in '37.
